US Banks Enhance AI Agent Controls Amid Security Concerns

US banks are increasing oversight of AI agents following incidents involving OpenAI and Hugging Face, which have heightened security and liability concerns. This move reflects a broader trend of financial institutions scrutinizing the use of artificial intelligence due to potential risks.
